One protocol is gRPC-Gateway (REST). Its registration is in server/router/api/v1/v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. The second protocol remains to be identified.

The second protocol is Connect. Its registration is in server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go via NewMemoServiceHandler. A native gRPC server registration may also exist.

gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP) is registered in v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. The second protocol has not yet been identified.

The second protocol is Connect RPC. Method wrapping occurs in connect_services.go. Handler registration happens in connect_handler.go via RegisterConnectHandlers, which is also invoked from v1.go.

Checking whether a native gRPC server exists, since Connect comments mention both native gRPC and Connect protocols. MCP was considered but ruled out as a third protocol.

message.text:
The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP at /api/v1/*) and Connect RPC (/memos.api.v1.*). Registration paths are being identified.

gRPC-Gateway registration occurs in server/router/api/v1/v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. Connect RPC wrapping happens in connect_handler.go and connect_services.go, with registration invoked from v1.go.

The final answer uses server/router/api/v1/v1.go for gRPC-Gateway and server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go for Connect.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `v1.go` registers MemoService on the gRPC-Gateway mux via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect wrapping/registration is `ConnectServiceHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers` in `connect_handler.go` (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`); per-RPC wrappers live in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.
